using namespace std;
using ll = long long;

const int N = 250005;
int n, kk, P;
ll fact[N], invFact[N], memo[26][N];

ll modPow(ll a, ll b) {
    ll ret = 1;
    while (b) {
        if (b & 1) ret = ret * a % P;
        a = a * a % P;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return ret;
}

inline int lowbit(int x) {
    return x & -x;
}

    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    cin >> n >> kk >> P;
    ll ans = modPow(kk, n);

    if (n & 1) {
        cout << ans << '\n';
        return 0;
    }

    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
        fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % P;

    invFact[n] = modPow(fact[n], P - 2);
    for (int i = n; i > 0; --i)
        invFact[i - 1] = invFact[i] * i % P;

    memset(memo, -1, sizeof(memo));

    function<ll(int,int)> dfs;
    dfs = [&](int cur, int mask) -> ll {
        if (memo[cur][mask] != -1) return memo[cur][mask];

        if (mask == 0) {
            ll val = fact[n];
            for (int i = 1; i <= cur; ++i)
                val = val * (kk - i + 1) % P;
            memo[cur][mask] = val;
            return val;
        }

        int rest = mask - lowbit(mask);
        ll val = 0;
        for (int sub = rest; sub > 0; sub = (sub - 1) & rest)
            val = (val + invFact[mask - sub] * dfs(cur + 1, sub)) % P;
        val = (val + invFact[mask] * dfs(cur + 1, 0)) % P;

        memo[cur][mask] = val;
        return val;
    };

    ans = (ans - dfs(0, n) + P) % P;
    cout << ans << '\n';
    return 0;

const int N = 250005;

ll modPow(ll a, ll b) {
    ll ret = 1;
    while (b) {
        if (b & 1) ret = ret * a % P;
        a = a * a % P;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return ret;
}

inline int lowbit(int x) {
    return x & -x;
}

struct Frame {
    int cur, mask, stage;
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    cin >> n >> kk >> P;
    ll ans = modPow(kk, n);

    if (n & 1) {
        cout << ans << '\n';
        return 0;
    }

    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
        fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % P;

    invFact[n] = modPow(fact[n], P - 2);
    for (int i = n; i > 0; --i)
        invFact[i - 1] = invFact[i] * i % P;

    memset(memo, -1, sizeof(memo));

    stack<Frame> st;
    st.push({0, n, 0});

    while (!st.empty()) {
        Frame f = st.top();

        if (memo[f.cur][f.mask] != -1) {
            st.pop();
            continue;
        }

        if (f.mask == 0) {
            ll val = fact[n];
            for (int i = 1; i <= f.cur; ++i)
                val = val * (kk - i + 1) % P;
            memo[f.cur][f.mask] = val;
            st.pop();
            continue;
        }

        if (f.stage == 0) {
            st.top().stage = 1;
            int rest = f.mask - lowbit(f.mask);

            for (int sub = rest; sub > 0; sub = (sub - 1) & rest)
                st.push({f.cur + 1, sub, 0});
            st.push({f.cur + 1, 0, 0});
        } else {
            int rest = f.mask - lowbit(f.mask);
            ll val = 0;

            for (int sub = rest; sub > 0; sub = (sub - 1) & rest)
                val = (val + invFact[f.mask - sub] * memo[f.cur + 1][sub]) % P;
            val = (val + invFact[f.mask] * memo[f.cur + 1][0]) % P;

            memo[f.cur][f.mask] = val;
            st.pop();
        }
    }

    ans = (ans - memo[0][n] + P) % P;
    cout << ans << '\n';
    return 0;
}
